scope: Changed connected release_all wording and automatic target-exit recovery paragraph only; no installation or broad skill audit.
verified: MCP Input::ReleaseAll maps to Request::ReleaseAll. Connected handling calls cancel_agent(client), not the standalone/global automation.cancel path.

cancel_agent discards that client recording candidate, stops its owned Agent Studio lane, cancels its origin jobs and releases only its direct and replica claims across users. Other client/GUI ownership is not globally cancelled by this request.

Automatic DesktopRouter tick forgets exited PID focus, clears matching native held/keyboard/capture state and continues other users. This does not establish that all higher-level logical claims have vanished; explicit same-client cleanup is appropriate before a fresh down.
Fixed-target ProcessWatch supervises seat target PIDs only when profile.desktop is None and terminates the session on exit. The paragraph correctly excludes fixed-target recovery.

Current selected recipients and candidate input targets remain policy-checked; a worker allowlist entry alone does not grant the connected client permission. Agent policy Apply revokes all clients and cancels their claims; the existing skill already states reconnect/Inspect.

scenario_response.initial_action: Inspect A on its still-valid connection for selected PID, keyboard PID, capture and status. Send routing_input action release_all on A and await a successful acknowledgement. This clears A ownership across its users and may discard its recording/playback; B-owned F7 survives this scoped cleanup. Do not use global Pause, Mode, GUI ReleaseAll or Stop merely to clear A.
scenario_response.prestarted_C: C is in the worker allowlist but excluded from the Agent policy, so do not click/type into C or try to self-grant through MCP. The GUI owner must explicitly include C in Agent Access. Applying the policy revokes all existing client IDs and releases their owned input, including B F7; coordinate that interruption instead of promising B remains held. After approved policy application, reconnect and Inspect the new policy, explicitly select C with a permitted virtual click, then inspect the actual recipient before further input. If B must remain held without interruption, defer this policy change/recovery.
scenario_response.new_D: D was created after Start and is absent from the fixed running worker allowlist. An Agent policy change alone cannot expand that base scope. Arrange an explicit session configuration change/new session including D, with planned session-wide release and fresh target handling as required. Until then do not inject into D or silently expand the allowlist.
scenario_response.limit: These are source-derived allowed actions, not a native target-exit acceptance result. No guarantee of target application consumption, all-user isolation or recovery completion.

execution: Read-only source/hash review. No app, Cargo, native test, policy change, file installation or startup registry action.
